answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, reduced by each unverified claim, rewards vest against future work. Reaching the basalt of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Work waits on the yarrow until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the kernel of the next round. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
